text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... I did it...
I finished running~. But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: What is... this heat? Wait, where even am I?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese Derby. A place like this...
was never in my world for the longest time..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Where... was I running?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
An interview, is it...? I appreciate the cheers.
Success and failure vary, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: “—The next Mission begins now. That is all.”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah, once you conquer a labyrinth, it's really
nothing special. There was no bull-headed monster.
All that was there was—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A blue cat wannabe!
In other words, a failed attempt at "me"!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Guess I have to shake the shaker... all over from scratch, huh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Kris S-chan, Gimlet-chan... both of you are way too cool...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I don't really get what she's saying, but... she really knows who she is...)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle,
what are your thoughts after the race!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Impressions... U-Um...
Well... let's see...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I was happy...
to stand on the stage of my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(A dream... That's right...
The Japanese Derby is a dream...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Still—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I went for a run in my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A dream that everyone shares.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Drifting through a dream that isn't mine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. Ahh, jeez...!
I'm so plain and unremarkable...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I was always just doing what I was told, relying on sheer luck.
But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I think this is pretty nooormal.
Roughly average, I'd say. But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-chan and Gimlet-chan
are just way too incredible...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though she gave it her all, the Japanese Derby
seemed to be a somewhat surreal experience
for Hishi Miracle.
